title: ZFinal Web Framework
description: Production-hardened Zig web framework inspired by JFinal. Fiber-based async server, ActiveRecord ORM, plugin system, 17 utility kits.

major_milestones.theme: AsyncServer, template engine, cache, cron, i18n
Framework unification, WebSocket, Redis, Docker, codegen

architecture_shifts: v0.3.0: Merged Server + AsyncServer into single fiber-based async server
v0.3.0: Replaced global PRNG with OS CSPRNG (arc4random/getrandom)
v0.3.0: Added structured Logger with compile-time log levels
v0.4.0: Full PostgreSQL + MySQL driver implementations (opt-in)
v0.4.0: Schema-driven CRUD code generation (zf crud:sql)
v0.4.0: Redis RESP protocol client over TCP
v0.4.0: WebSocket close handshake + frame fragmentation
v0.4.0: .life project memory system for AI self-evolution
key_decisions: 001: Fiber-based server over thread-pool for scalability and zero heap allocation
002: CSPRNG over deterministic PRNG for all security-sensitive operations
003: Schema-driven code generation as primary AI workflow
004: Error-isolation pattern for Group.async Cancelable!void constraint
005: opt-in native drivers (libpq/mysqlclient) with zero-dependency default
